warnings: Synthetic data: prices are simulated. A result here tests the machinery and the rules on a random process with built-in regimes, not a market edge.

flags: The 95% interval of the mean R includes zero: no evidence of an edge.

Selected min_score=75.0 sits at the edge of the grid; the best region may lie outside it (or it is fitting noise).

assumptions: Decisions use only bars closed at decision time; higher timeframes only complete bars.
Entries are market orders filled at the next bar's open plus slippage.
Inside a bar the stop is assumed to be hit before the target when both are touched.
A stop crossed inside a bar fills at its level plus slippage; a gap through it fills at the open.
Charges follow the configured cost model; slippage is applied on every fill.
One trade at a time; daily loss limit, max trades and consecutive-loss stop as live.
Positions are squared off at 15:15 IST; no new entries after 15:00 IST.
Cross-symbol relative-strength rank is not used in backtests (it does not change scores).

walk_forward.note: Efficiency = mean test expectancy (R) / mean train expectancy (R); near 1 means results held up on unseen days, near 0 or negative means they did not.
